# Email Templates

Professional templates for common engineering and cross-functional communication scenarios. Adapt the bracketed fields for each use.

---

## 1. Technical Incident Notification (Initial)

**Subject:** [INCIDENT] [SERVICE/SYSTEM] — [Brief description] — [Severity: P1/P2/P3]

---

Team,

**Incident Summary**  
[One sentence describing what is broken and the customer-facing impact.]

**Status:** Investigating | Identified | Mitigating | Resolved  
**Detected:** [YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC]  
**Severity:** P[1/2/3] — [e.g. "Production data pipeline halted; no data loss confirmed"]  
**Incident Commander:** [Name]

**Current Understanding**  
[What is known so far. Be factual, not speculative. Two to three sentences.]

**Immediate Actions Taken**  
- [Action 1 and by whom]
- [Action 2 and by whom]

**Next Update**  
[Time of next update, e.g. "In 30 minutes or when status changes."]

[Name]  
[Team]

---

## 2. Incident Post-Mortem Distribution

**Subject:** Post-Mortem: [INCIDENT ID] — [Service] — [Date]

---

Team,

The post-mortem for incident [ID] is complete and available at [link].

**Summary**  
[Two to three sentences: what happened, root cause, and duration of impact.]

**Root Cause**  
[One sentence. Be precise.]

**Key Timeline Points**  
- [HH:MM] — [Event]
- [HH:MM] — [Event]
- [HH:MM] — [Resolved]

**Action Items**

| Item | Owner | Due Date |
|---|---|---|
| [Action] | [Name] | [Date] |
| [Action] | [Name] | [Date] |

Please review and raise any corrections or additions by [date].

[Name]

---

## 3. Design Review Request

**Subject:** Design Review Request — [Feature/System Name] — [Target review date]

---

Hi [Reviewer Name / Team],

I am requesting a design review for [feature or system]. The design document is linked below.

**What this covers:** [Two sentences on scope — what decision or design is being reviewed.]

**Why your input is needed:** [Specific expertise or stake they have in this decision.]

**Document:** [Link]  
**Review deadline:** [Date]  
**Estimated read time:** ~[N] minutes

Key questions I would like feedback on:

1. [Specific question]
2. [Specific question]

I am available for a synchronous walk-through on [available dates/times] if that would be more efficient.

[Name]

---

## 4. Technical Escalation to Management

**Subject:** Escalation Required — [Technical Risk or Blocker] — [Project/Team]

---

[Manager Name],

I am escalating a technical risk that requires a decision at your level.

**Situation**  
[Two to three sentences. What is the problem, and what specifically requires a decision or resource that is outside my authority.]

**Impact if unresolved**  
[Concrete consequence: delivery date slip, data quality risk, compliance gap, etc.]

**Options**  
1. [Option A] — [Expected outcome and trade-off]
2. [Option B] — [Expected outcome and trade-off]

**My Recommendation**  
[State which option you recommend and the primary reason.]

**Decision Needed By**  
[Date — and why that date is the constraint.]

I am available to discuss today or tomorrow. Let me know what works.

[Name]

---

## 5. Stakeholder Status Update (Weekly / Sprint)

**Subject:** [Project Name] — Status Update — Week of [Date]

---

Hi [Stakeholder Name / Distribution List],

**Status:** On Track | At Risk | Blocked  
**Sprint / Period:** [Sprint number or date range]

**Completed This Period**  
- [Deliverable 1]
- [Deliverable 2]

**In Progress**  
- [Item 1] — [Expected completion]
- [Item 2] — [Expected completion]

**Blockers / Risks**  
- [Blocker description and owner of resolution, if applicable]

**Next Period Focus**  
- [Planned work item 1]
- [Planned work item 2]

Reach out if you have questions or if priorities have shifted.

[Name]

---

## 6. Requesting Technical Feedback on Code or Architecture

**Subject:** Feedback Request — [PR / Design Title] — [Deadline]

---

Hi [Name],

I would value your review of [the attached PR / design doc] before [date/decision point].

**Context:** [One paragraph. What is being built, why, and where this fits in the larger system.]

**Specific areas I want feedback on:**  
- [Area 1 — e.g., "Is the error propagation strategy appropriate for async pipeline use?"]
- [Area 2]

**Link:** [PR or document URL]  
**Time required:** ~[N] minutes

No need for a line-by-line review — high-level architectural comments are most useful at this stage.

[Name]

---

## 7. Professional Inquiry / Collaboration Request

**Subject:** [Research / Collaboration / Technical Question] — [Specific Topic] — [Your Name]

---

[Name],

My name is [Your Name]. I am a [Your Role] at [Organization], working on [one-sentence context on your relevant background — a specific system, domain, or research area].

**Reason for contact**  
[One to two sentences. What specifically prompted you to reach out — their published work, a public talk, a shared domain problem, an open-source contribution. Be precise; generic outreach is easy to dismiss.]

**Technical context**  
[Three to four sentences. Describe the problem, system, or research question. State what you have already tried or explored so the recipient understands the starting point.]

**What I am asking**  
[State the specific ask: a 20-minute call, written feedback on a design approach, co-authorship discussion, access to a dataset, a pointer to an existing solution. Do not leave this implicit.]

**Why this may be of mutual interest**  
[One sentence. What value does this exchange create for the recipient, not just for you.]

[Attach or link a relevant artifact if it substantiates the request — a design doc, repository, draft, or brief.]

[Your Name]  
[Title / Role]  
[Contact / Profile URL]
